P7000330's right shoulder (760,650-1010,900) is the clearest case: the shoulder-seam and fold lines are frankly discontinuous short dashes with open gaps between them, and the fold strokes taper to dry points. P7000329's shoulder contour (820,640-1024,844) swells and thins to near-nothing at the top and its interior strokes are broken tapered marks. So broken/dry character is present in the contours, not absent.

Coloring (transparent_glaze): the "flat opaque cel fill" reading is also a thumbnail artifact. Seed 1001 is clean (cool violet-grey skin, coherent). The two flagged seeds do NOT show the described defect at full resolution:

- Seed 2002 (P7000689): skin is a desaturated cool sage/teal, and it is not flat — there are legible planes (forehead, cheek, jaw, neck). The violet is not random patching: it sits as a narrow rim band along the hairline and jaw underside, plus eyelids/eye sockets and brows, with soft transitions. Lips are warm rose. The face reads as one unified head.
- Seed 3003 (P7000690): the "hard green/violet patches" are, at full res, anatomically placed and soft-edged — a warm cream rim light running down the cheek/jaw contour and over the nose ridge, mauve in the eye sockets and philtrum, a pale forehead plane highlight, violet along the hairline. Value is near-constant across all regions (0.329-0.392), i.e. the colour shifts are low-contrast chroma variation — exactly what collapses into apparent "patchiness" when downsampled to a contact-sheet thumbnail, and exactly what resolves into smooth planar shading at full size.

saturation_screen.json (group_axis = coloring, deviation 0.5) also gives no support: the cool_nocturne group has median 0.1909, range 0.1663-0.2319, and outlier_count 0 — this item is not a saturation outlier, and outlier_total across all 300 items is 0.
